prose: The naturopathic healer and all around thought-leader for truth, health, and freedom, Amandha Vollmer, joins InnerVerse! As the founder of the Yum Naturals Emporium, Amandha and her team handcraft unique botanical blends of the utmost quality. In this flow-state chat, we get to know one another and enjoy an explorative conversation down many inspired avenues.
